name: Gravel V3 RS / Sensah 2×12

editorial.verdict: Cheapest traceable carbon complete; the obvious choice when purchase price matters most.
strengths: Full carbon frame/fork/cockpit package at an unusually low complete-bike price
caveats: Maximum clearance is not clearly published
Frame-molding provenance and model-specific testing are not transparent
Exact component substitutions must be checked

purchase_route: Shenzhen manufacturer direct-contact route plus an official factory-store exact RS 24-speed listing; the last mainland price evidence is the dated CNY 3,991 observation from 2026-08-05, so current stock, warranty and checkout total remain to be confirmed
claimed_frame_weight_basis: Official factory-store current T47 RS listing, size M and unpainted; hardware and weighing method were not stated
claimed_complete_weight_basis: Best exact RS 24-speed claim: official factory store, size 50 cm, without pedals. The main manufacturer states 9.9 kg with basis unstated and a regional page states 9.7–9.9 kg; the conflicting claims remain in source metadata
